title: Generated invoice PDF is blank for multi-page orders
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in BillingPro, the user encountered: Generated invoice PDF is blank for multi-page orders.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Order #8821
2. Observe UI state: Generating PDF...
3. Observe UI state: Blank page

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Blank page.

## Environment
- App: BillingPro
- Platform: desktop
